description:
Prune is a playable Anemo character in Genshin Impact .

A self-proclaimed "Witch Hunter" who traveled from Nod-Krai to Mondstadt to look for Alice after she "kidnapped" her imaginary friend Descartes . There, Prune meets Alice's daughter, Klee , and plasters Mondstadt with posters antagonizing Alice, which no one takes seriously.
role_summary: Prune is an Anemo support character who provides DMG bonuses to her teammates. After casting her Elemental Skill , Prune strikes the "Witchlure Bell," dealing Anemo DMG. If this attack triggers a Swirl reaction, then for a short duration, the element involved in that Swirl will cause the "Banehunter Oathhammer" to undergo Elemental Conversion. Prune can then tap the skill again to unleash an attack dealing DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type. After casting her Elemental Burst , the "Witchlure Bell" enters the "Hunter-Seeker" mode, periodically attacking nearby enemies. After unlocking the Ascension Talent Verdict and Punishment , if these attacks deal DMG and trigger a Swirl reaction, a "Banehunter Oathhammer" with the corresponding Elemental Conversion will be summoned before the enemy, slamming down and dealing corresponding Elemental DMG. After unlocking the Ascension Talent Tolling Synchronicity , whenever Prune deals DMG using an Elemental Converted "Banehunter Oathhammer," all nearby party members gain the "Tolling Rally" effect, increasing their DMG.

talents.name: Badaboom! Hexbuster Hammer
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 3 attacks by swinging the Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing Anemo DMG . Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and performs an upward hammer swing, dealing Anemo DMG to opponents in front. Plunging Attack Calling upon the power of Anemo, she plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.

talents.name: Witchseeker's Vow
talents.description: After completing Witch's Homework : Of What Is Contested , Prune becomes a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you gain the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, which enhances Hexerei characters. Hexerei: Secret Rite After a Hexerei character in the party affected by the Tolling Rally effect triggers an Elemental Reaction on an opponent, Prune's ATK is increased by 60% for 5s. If the Elemental Reaction triggered is a Swirl Reaction, the triggering character's ATK will additionally be increased by 30% for 5s.
